tests: Choosing a service when an HSM under the company's exclusive control on dedicated hardware is required.
expected: AWS CloudHSM — dedicated single-tenant FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM; only the customer manages the keys. Triggers: "hardware security modules the company controls exclusively", "single-tenant dedicated hardware".
why_not: KMS — multi-tenant managed service; Secrets Manager stores secrets; ACM — TLS certificates.
